title: Story log: every change, wish and spot recorded, and a /story/ page to read it
body:
A record of how the island grows, written automatically so the project can tell its own story later.

- **Every commit that reaches main** gets a record on a new `story` branch (never main, so no deploys and no extra weight on the site): the PR's words, the idea-box wish it answers in the visitor's own words, who made it and with which tools, a census (spots, characters, scenes…), and **before/after photos** of the place, taken from builds of both commits, plus a moving loop.
- **Every idea-box wish** is kept exactly as first sent.
- **Mondays**: a photo of every art spot, a time-lapse whether or not anything changed.
- Each run catches up on whatever is missing, so a cancelled or skipped run loses nothing.
- **`/story/`**: a page that reads the log live from the branch (growth charts, a before/after wipe, wishes still waiting). Not linked from the map; `noindex`.
- PRs now have a **`## Story`** section (template + CLAUDE.md): `Idea`, `Where` (where to point the camera), `Asked vs made`, `Mike`, `Note`. `Mike:` is only ever Mike's own words.

@exit320-stack: heads-up, since this changes what goes in your PR descriptions. The Story lines are how your words and the "asked vs made" end up in the record. Details: `scripts/story/README.md`.

Once merged I'll run the workflow once with a high limit to backfill all ~74 past changes.

## Story
Idea:
Where: none
Asked vs made:
Mike:
Note: The log's first entry is the change that starts the log. The recorder was tried locally on 12 real changes; a regex that read the build's base path from a comment cost the recent ones their photos until fixed.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

Story log: every change, wish and spot, recorded to the story branch

Each commit that reaches main gets a record (facts from git + the PR, the
wish it answers in the visitor's words, the PR's new "## Story" section,
who made it and with which tools, a census) plus before/after photos of
the place, built from both commits. Idea-box wishes are kept as first
sent; Mondays photograph every spot. A README chronicle and story.json
index sit on top. Written by .github/workflows/story.yml to the story
branch, never main; every run catches up on anything missed.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.message:
/story/: a page that shows the story log (not linked from the map yet)

Reads story.json live from the story branch: counts, small-multiple growth
charts, every change by month and day with its wish, words, a before/after
wipe and the moving loop, and the wishes still waiting. story.json now
carries everything the page needs. Recorder fixes found on the way: serve
each build at its real base (a comment fooled the regex), count scenes in
their folders. Smoke test opens /story/ on a made-up log.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
